purpose: Install and interpret the public IP-quality checker release without accessing its private implementation.
notes: Use public oneclickvirt/securityCheck release artifacts only. Do not fetch or publish the private security repository. Verify the installed binary help; network-provider failures are unknown findings, not proof of reputation.
purpose_zh: 使用公开 IP 质量检测产物，不访问其私有实现仓库。
notes_zh: 仅使用公开 oneclickvirt/securityCheck Release，不拉取或公开私有 security 源码。先核对已安装程序的帮助；上游数据库请求失败应记为未知。
